DomainData.MainInfoText:
In order to provide you with free high-quality content that you love to watch and offers that are more relevant to you, the National Football League and our third-party partners collect and share certain personal information. Because we respect your privacy, we also provide you choices with respect to your personal information. You may use the toggles in the sections below to opt out of certain types of tracking (conducted via cookies, pixels, and other technologies), including restricting the use of your information in a way that may be deemed to result in the “sale” or “sharing” of personal information under certain United States laws. If you choose to opt out of these types of tracking, you will still see ads, though they may be less relevant to you. Note that in some instances you may also still observe cookies on your browser, but we send consent signals to such third parties to restrict the use of that information consistent with your privacy preferences.

You are always free to turn optional tracking back on using this privacy preference center.
